implementation: The source validator keeps lexical tag scope across nested functions. U1 lowers closed GO through a fresh captured cons tag, CATCH, THROW and indexed redispatch. The per-function backend map still starts empty. Same-function TAGBODYs proven to have no GO beneath pending emitter frames use ordinary Wasm branches; other loops keep the reviewed addressed-exit implementation.
proof: GO is branchable only in statement position, IF arms, PROGN or declaration bodies for a tag in this TAGBODY. IF tests must contain no GO. Other forms may execute but must contain no local GO; literal data and separately emitted function bodies are not traversed as same-function code. Nested loop transfers, operand evaluation, retained values, bindings and cleanups conservatively take the unwind path.
verification: Thirty native-first cases at low/high memory placements with and without legal collection; the accepted LL06 corpus reruns unchanged. Independent function-body inspection rejects control-push or exit-throw instructions in four eligible modules. Seven recompiled mutants cover wrong targets, skipped backedges/fallthrough, unsafe branches, stale captured cells, wrong catch identity and unnecessary unwind overhead. Six source refusals remain.
limitations: This is a closure-control prerequisite, not LL12-a qualification. The existing function-object arity and debug words are still NIL; keyword-vector and debug-metadata preservation through installation remains required for that slot.
Nested GO crossing pending root or dynamic extents still pays the addressed-exit cost. The proof is deliberately conservative, and no elapsed-time speed claim is made.

An expired closed target is a target safety refusal. One retained case also matches native control-error, but behaviour outside the target's dynamic extent is not a portable Lisp guarantee. A development case reached a reused native stack catch; it is retained and is not used as a native identity oracle. The final identity test uses two simultaneously live catch extents.
The collector and runtime sources are unchanged. Collections occur at legal published service calls, not arbitrary instructions. General LOOP/DO source macros remain outside this admitted subset.
Shared source stays at accepted LL06 until this isolated proposal is reviewed and accepted. R6/R6a is newly executed for the exact compiler proposal.
